name: Remove task
description: Remove task Removes a task from a file. DELETE /2.0/tasks/{task_id}

name: Get task
description: Get task Retrieves information about a specific task. GET /2.0/tasks/{task_id}

name: List task assignments
description: List task assignments Lists all of the assignments for a given task. GET /2.0/tasks/{task_id}/assignments
context:
GET /2.0/tasks/{task_id}/assignments
Lists all of the assignments for a given task.
Required: task_id (path) — The ID of the task.

name: Create task
description: Create task Creates a single task on a file. POST /2.0/tasks
context:
POST /2.0/tasks
Creates a single task on a file. This task is not assigned to any user and will need to be assigned separately.
Optional: body (body)

name: Update task
description: Update task Updates a task. PUT /2.0/tasks/{task_id}
context:
PUT /2.0/tasks/{task_id}
Updates a task. This can be used to update a task's configuration, or to update its completion state.
Required: task_id (path) — The ID of the task.
Optional: body (body)
